priority_basis: conservative reviewer queue order; not estimated harm probability or clinical severity
identity_policy: only explicit independent annotation flags count; lexical tokens and reference speaker labels do not establish an identity or role error
dose_policy: a dose or strength cue requires an explicit numeric-unit span or independent dose_context annotation; a bare number is counted only as number_or_unit
overlap_policy: one edit may match multiple categories; category counts are not additive
